card.description:
**About the Team**

Dow Jones Energy is a leading global energy intelligence business providing trusted price reporting from our specialist Price Reporting Agency (PRA) OPIS, Chemical Market Analytics (CMA) and McCloskey, proprietary data, market intelligence, news and research to help customers navigate increasingly interconnected energy markets. Through our specialist businesses, Dow Jones Energy makes it easier to discover and access trusted expertise spanning oil and gas, chemicals, refined fuels, coal, electric vehicle infrastructure and renewables. Our specialist businesses combine rigorous pricing methodologies with world-class human judgment to deliver the trusted intelligence and specialist insight customers need to make confident decisions.

**About the Role**

The Director of Business Optimization & Operational Excellence will play a pivotal role in transforming commercial operations into a highly efficient, value-impacting engine. Reporting directly to the VP of Operational Excellence, this role is tasked with managing the Business Optimization team driving the end-to-end Customer Journey process improvement, strengthening commercial and commercial operations execution, and enabling sustainable business growth. In addition, implement systematic collection of VOC across customer facing functions for actionable insights.The successful candidate will leverage Lean management frameworks, process mapping methodologies, automation technologies, and advanced Salesforce CRM optimization to eliminate friction across commercial workflows. Furthermore, this role will champion cross-functional alignment and operational efficiency across critical commercial partnering functions, including Sales Excellence, Customer Service, Sales Coordination, RevOps, Marketing, Billing and Legal teams.

**You Will**

* Process Mapping, Streamlining & Lean Optimization

* Workflow Documentation: Map existing end-to-end commercial operations, creating comprehensive As-Is process maps, standard operating procedures, and To-Be future-state designs.
* Lean & Continuous Improvement: Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies to identify operational bottlenecks, redundancies, waste, and friction points across departments.
* Optimization Execution: Redesign Lead to Cash workflows to reduce cycle times, minimize error rates, eliminate rework, and enhance overall service delivery quality.
* Customer Journey Optimization: Partner with marketing, sales and sales operations to design, evaluate, and refine automated lead journeys that nurture prospects and generate high-intent sales leads.

* Salesforce CRM Maximization & Commercial Enablement

* Salesforce Utilization & Optimization: Serve as the primary business bridge between commercial teams and Salesforce administrators to enhance user adoption, workflow automation, lead-to-cash process efficiency, and pipeline management.
* Commercial Execution & Sales Enablement: Streamline sales workflows, lead routing, opportunity tracking, and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) integration to remove administrative burden from sales.
* Manage the implementation of digital adoption training tools (WalkMe).

* Process Innovation, Digital Transformation & Automation

* Automation Tool Integration: Identify and champion innovative technology solutions, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI-driven workflows, smart forms, and document management automation.
* Digital Workflow Solutions: Modernize manual, e-mail based, paper-based, or spreadsheet-heavy tasks across commercial and support operations into automated digital tools.

* Cross-Functional Support Team Operational Efficiency

* Commercial Support Optimization: Drive operational excellence across Customer Service, Contract Support, and Sales Coordinator teams to align service metrics with commercial growth objectives.
* Customer Service & Order Execution: Enhance ticket resolution workflows, order management, and inquiry handling to improve Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and key SLA performance.

**You Have**

**Experience**

* 12+ years of progressive professional experience in business operations, management consulting, or commercial operational excellence.
* 4-5+ years of direct people management, with proven success leading optimization or continuous improvement teams
* **Lean / Six Sigma:** Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification strongly preferred.
* **Salesforce Expertise:** Proven experience optimizing Salesforce CRM from a business/ operational perspective (Salesforce Administrator certification or deep business architecture experience is a strong plus).

**Skills & Technical Proficiencies**

* **Process Mapping Tools** : Advanced proficiency in Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, or similar workflow mapping platforms.
* **Sales Enablement & CRM** : Deep understanding of Salesforce functionality, pipeline hygiene, reports/dashboards, and automated commercial workflows.
* **Change Management & Leadership** : Strong stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive change adoption without direct line authority.

**Our Benefits**

* Comprehensive Insurance & Retirement plans
* Paid Time Off and Leaves
* Education Benefits
* Family Care Benefits
* Career Growth Programs
* Access to Dow Jones Products
* Employee Referral Program
* Employee Well-being Support & Fitness Programs
* Financial Health Programs
* Cybersecurity Protection

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

**Reasonable Accommodation**

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application and/or interview process. If you need assistance or accommodation in completing your application or participating in an interview due to a disability, email us at talentresourceteam@dowjones.com. Please put "Reasonable Accommodation" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. This inbox will not be monitored for application status updates.

Please refer to the privacy notice at the bottom of this page for submitting any data access, deletion, or other data subject rights requests, where permitted under your local laws and regulations.

**Job Category: General Management**

**Union Status:**

**Non-Union role**

**Dow Jones is a global provider of news and business information, delivering content to consumers and organizations around the world across multiple formats, including print, digital, mobile and live events. Dow Jones has produced unrivaled quality content for more than 130 years and today has one of the world’s largest newsgathering operations globally.**

**It is home to leading publications and products including the flagship Wall Street Journal, America’s largest newspaper by paid circulation; Barron’s, MarketWatch, Mansion Global, Financial News, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance and Dow Jones Newswires. Dow Jones is a division of News Corp (Nasdaq: NWS, NWSA; ASX: NWS, NWSLV).**

card.title: Director of Operational Excellence
card.description:
Job Summary - Why you’ll love this position

Are you motivated by the challenge of solving complex, enterprise-wide problems? Do you love asking "why" and transforming good operations into exceptional public experiences? If so, consider joining the State of Missouri as our next Director of Operational Excellence!

In this pivotal leadership role you will champion continuous improvement across state government, lead our operational initiatives, and oversee our statewide customer experience program. This position resides within the Office of Administration, the administrative arm of the executive branch, but leads efforts that span all executive agencies to improve service delivery to the citizens of Missouri.

We are seeking an energetic, visionary executive to lead and empower a dedicated team of process improvement and customer experience efforts while serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership, agency partners, and frontline public servants. Our next director is a bridge-builder who combines proven improvement methodologies with human-centered design, modern customer experience principles, rapid responsiveness to agency partner needs, and a passion for coaching state team members to achieve measurable public outcomes.

In addition to the inspiring work that will improve the services provided by state government and your colleagues work environment, you will receive a great benefits package that includes paid time off, medical/vision/dental insurance, life insurance, and retirement.

*The salary indicated represents a base pay rate. If the individual selected or the position is eligible for a pay differential (e.g., shift, security, or years of service), it will be added to the total compensation in your paycheck. A pay differential does not raise your base pay.*

Responsibilities - What you’ll do

* Work collaboratively with leadership and teams to encourage, develop, and execute strategies to create a culture of continuous improvement across Missouri state government. Measure the effectiveness of improvements and provide administration with visibility to such improvements.
* Act as a subject matter expert and promote change management by sharing Lean Six Sigma and other Operational Excellence best practices. Teach, mentor, coach and lead Operational Excellence leaders from every state department.
* Continuously provide helpful operational excellence resources for team members and facilitate training sessions.
* Model excellence in leadership and act with urgency to achieve results and lead efforts to cultivate a culture of data-based decision making.
* Facilitate, lead, and oversee state level strategic initiatives and other projects as assigned by leadership.
* Coordinate and host an annual Show Me Excellence Summit and represent the State of Missouri at national operational excellence events.

Qualifications - All you need for success

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Formal training in Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent continuous process improvement framework. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge in Lean and Operational Excellence frameworks and facilitation methodologies
* Hands-on experience work with survey, feedback, or data visualization platforms, such as Qualtrics, Tableau, or Power BI

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Must be action oriented, demonstrate superior organizational abilities and have strong facilitation skills and excellent communications skills.
* Ability to work with leaders and multi-level teams to establish goals, performance indicators, actions plans and deliverables and effectively communicating across broad audiences.
* Must have excellent leadership abilities. This individual must be an effective collaborator with energy, enthusiasm and a can-do attitude who can empower others, gain buy-in and achieve results.
* Good understanding of data analysis related to process improvement and an ability to analyze data to gain insights and support problem solving.
* Training, certification, and/or education in continuous process improvement programs such as Lean Six Sigma as well as completion of Missouri Way, Leadership Academy, and similar programs is preferred.

***Lack of post******‐******secondary education will not be used as the sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.***

Successful background check results are required for employment in this position. This may include background checks involving a candidate's name and/or fingerprints and other screenings as needed for the specific position.

Authorization to work in the United States is a prerequisite of employment. The Office of Administration will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Job Details - More reasons to love this position

The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. To help demonstrate the value of working for the State of Missouri, we have created an interactive Total Compensation Calculator. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

Contact Details - If you have questions or require any accommodations to participate in the application or interview process please contact:

OARecruiters@oa.mo.gov

The State of Missouri is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to developing and maintaining a talented workforce.

Plant Manager

**Piedmont, South Carolina | Industrial Adhesives**

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Plant Manager** to lead our manufacturing operation in **Piedmont, South Carolina**. This is a highly visible leadership role for a proven manufacturing leader who can **drive change, develop high-performing teams, strengthen accountability, and deliver operational excellence**.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, people-focused leader who can set a clear vision, engage employees at all levels, challenge the status quo, and build a culture centered on **safety, quality, continuous improvement, collaboration, and results**.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide overall leadership and direction for plant operations, including **Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, People, and Continuous Improvement**.
* Lead **organizational and cultural change**, building employee engagement, accountability, and ownership.
* Develop, coach, and strengthen the plant leadership team while building the organization's future talent pipeline.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with EHS requirements.
* Drive operational excellence using **Lean Six Sigma, OEE, VSM, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement tools**.
* Deliver plant financial, productivity, quality, customer service, and inventory objectives.
* Partner across Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Sales, and other business functions to achieve business goals.
* Identify and eliminate barriers, improve processes, and create sustainable improvements in plant performance.
* Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor and actively engage with supervisors and employees.
* Lead and support capital investments and improvement initiatives aligned with business strategy.

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing, engineering, or operations experience.
* Proven manufacturing leadership experience with a strong record of **leading change and improving performance**.
* Demonstrated ability to **build, coach, and lead high-performing teams**.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to drive accountability and results.
* Experience with Lean Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Chemical, specialty chemical, adhesives, batch/process manufacturing, or similar experience preferred.

The Leader We're Looking For

You are a **visible, decisive, and engaging leader** who knows how to bring people along through change. You set clear expectations, hold yourself and others accountable, develop talent, and create an environment where employees are empowered to solve problems and improve the business.

Most importantly, you can **deliver today's results while transforming the organization for tomorrow**.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
**Compensation Range:**

$122,800 - $204,600

**Plant Manager**

Department: Operations / Manufacturing

Reports To: Director of Operations

Direct Reports: Production Managers, Facilities Manager, and other assigned manufacturing leadership

Scope: Three manufacturing buildings / multi-product HVAC manufacturing operation

**Position**

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and day-to-day execution of manufacturing operations across three buildings within a large HVAC manufacturing facility. This position provides hands-on leadership to ensure the plant safely produces high-quality products on schedule, at the required volume and cost, while developing a strong culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

The Plant Manager is responsible for coordinating production activities across multiple manufacturing processes and buildings, including assembly, sheet metal fabrication, welding, piping/refrigeration, testing, material flow, and final product completion.

The successful candidate will establish clear operating standards, drive cross-functional accountability, develop manufacturing leadership, remove operational constraints, and ensure the plant has the people, processes, equipment, and infrastructure required to support current production and future growth.

This position is expected to be highly visible on the manufacturing floor and serves as the primary operational leader responsible for translating business objectives into daily execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Plant Leadership & Operational Execution**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for manufacturing operations across all three buildings.
* Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operating priorities aligned with business requirements.
* Ensure production plans are executed safely, efficiently, and according to customer commitments.
* Maintain strong communication and coordination between buildings and manufacturing departments.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for production performance.
* Lead daily plant operating reviews and ensure corrective actions are completed.
* Identify and remove constraints affecting throughput, capacity, quality, or delivery.
* Maintain appropriate production capacity, staffing, equipment, and infrastructure to support business growth.
* Ensure standardized processes are consistently followed across all buildings.
* Maintain a strong management presence on the manufacturing floor.

**2. Production Management**

* Lead Production Managers and ensure effective management of production personnel.
* Establish production priorities based on customer demand, capacity, material availability, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure production schedules are achieved while balancing labor, equipment, materials, and testing capacity.
* Monitor production flow from fabrication through final assembly and testing.
* Develop and maintain effective production metrics and visual management systems.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to improve throughput.
* Ensure appropriate escalation processes are in place when production performance is at risk.
* Coordinate production activities between the three buildings to maximize overall plant capacity.

**3. Safety, Environmental & Compliance**

* Establish safety as the facility’s highest operational priority.
* Partner with EHS leadership to maintain a strong safety culture across all three buildings.
* Ensure compliance with OSHA, environmental regulations, company requirements, and applicable industry standards.
* Drive accountability for safe work practices at all levels of the organization.
* Ensure timely investigation and corrective action following incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions.
* Support programs designed to reduce injuries, ergonomic risks, environmental impacts, and workplace hazards.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate safety training and understand their responsibilities.

**4. Quality**

* Partner with Quality leadership to ensure products meet customer, engineering, and company requirements.
* Establish accountability for first-time quality and defect prevention.
* Drive reduction of scrap, rework, warranty issues, and production defects.
* Ensure quality issues are rapidly escalated and contained.
* Support root-cause analysis and corrective-action processes.
* Promote quality at the source rather than relying on downstream inspection.
* Maintain compliance with the plant's quality management system and ISO requirements.

**5. Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the implementation and sustainability of Lean Manufacturing Principles throughout all three buildings.
* Establish a culture of continuous improvement and employee involvement.
* Drive 5S, visual management, standardized work, problem solving, waste elimination, and flow improvements.
* Support Value Stream Mapping and improvement of end-to-end product flow.
* Establish measurable improvement targets for productivity, quality, delivery, inventory, and cost.
* Partner with Lean/Manufacturing Engineering leadership to prioritize improvement projects based on business impact.
* Ensure Lean improvements are sustained through management systems and standard work.
* Develop frontline leaders capable of independently identifying and solving operational problems.

**6. People Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Develop a high-performing manufacturing leadership team.
* Establish clear expectations, accountability, and performance standards.
* Coach and develop Production Managers, Supervisors, and other manufacturing leaders.
* Identify organizational capability gaps and work with Human Resources to develop staffing and development plans.
* Support workforce planning and hiring activities necessary to meet production requirements.
* Establish effective onboarding and training processes for new employees.
* Develop succession plans for key manufacturing positions.
* Promote employee engagement, teamwork, ownership, and accountability.
* Address performance issues promptly and consistently.

**7. Capacity & Business Growth**

* Develop manufacturing capacity plans to support current and future customer demand.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Finance, Materials, and other functions to identify capacity requirements.
* Evaluate labor, equipment, floor space, testing, utilities, and infrastructure requirements.
* Support capital planning and justification for new equipment and facility improvements.
* Ensure new production areas and buildings are effectively integrated into the overall manufacturing system.
* Develop ramp-up plans for new products, programs, and production transfers.
* Ensure the plant can scale production without compromising safety, quality, or delivery performance.

**8. Cross-Functional Leadership**

Work closely with:

* Director of Operations
* Production
* Materials
* Production Planning
* Logistics
* Quality
* EHS
* Lean / Manufacturing Engineering
* Facilities
* Maintenance
* Engineering
* Finance
* Human Resources
* Supply Chain
* Sales / Customer teams

Ensure cross-functional issues are identified early, assigned to the appropriate owner, and driven to resolution.

**9. Facilities, Equipment & Infrastructure**

* Partner with Facilities and Maintenance leadership to ensure buildings, utilities, production equipment, cranes, test infrastructure, and other critical assets support production requirements.
* Establish preventive and predictive maintenance expectations.
* Ensure critical production equipment has appropriate contingency plans.
* Support capital equipment selection, installation, commissioning, and production launch.
* Ensure facility expansion projects are integrated into manufacturing operations with minimal disruption to production.

**10. Performance Management & Accountability**

Establish and maintain a plant operating system based on measurable performance.

Key performance indicators should include:

Safety

* Recordable incident rate
* Lost-time incidents
* Near misses
* Safety observations
* Corrective-action closure

Quality

* First-pass yield
* Scrap
* Rework
* Customer defects
* Warranty / quality escapes

Delivery

* On-time delivery
* Schedule attainment
* Production attainment
* Manufacturing lead time
* Test-bay utilization / throughput

Productivity

* Labor productivity
* Units per labor hour
* OEE where applicable
* Direct labor efficiency
* Throughput

Cost

* Manufacturing cost
* Labor variance
* Scrap cost
* Overtime
* Cost of poor quality

Lean

* 5S performance
* Kaizen completion
* Standard work compliance
* Improvement savings
* Value-stream performance

The Plant Manager will ensure performance is reviewed routinely and that corrective actions have clearly identified owners and due dates.

**Leadership Expectations**

The Plant Manager is expected to:

* Lead from the floor rather than from the office.
* Establish a culture of accountability without creating a culture of blame.
* Make decisions based on facts and data.
* Escalate issues early rather than allowing problems to become emergencies.
* Develop leaders instead of personally solving every problem.
* Maintain a strong focus on safety and quality while driving production.
* Create alignment between the three buildings rather than allowing them to operate as independent plants.
* Establish consistent standards and expectations across the operation.
* Communicate clearly with employees, leadership, and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrate urgency while maintaining disciplined problem solving.

card.title: VP Manufacturing & Production
card.description:
About Us

 

Skydweller Aero Inc. is a transatlantic, cutting-edge aerospace company developing solar-powered aircraft solutions capable of perpetual flight while carrying heavy and powerful payloads. Building on technology from the longest continuous renewably powered flight program in history, this fast-growing company is creating a new class of unmanned aircraft. It combines the persistence of geosynchronous satellites with the sensing capabilities and flexibility of a large airborne platform. Skydweller Aero Inc. has its global and US headquarters in Oklahoma City, with European operations headquartered in Spain.

Role Summary

 

As Skydweller prepares to move from development toward aircraft production, we are looking for an experienced manufacturing executive to build and lead our production organization. This role is based in **Oklahoma City, OK** and reports to the Chief Operating Officer.

The Vice President, Manufacturing & Production will own all aircraft production operations: final assembly, systems integration, avionics installation, production testing, factory operations and aircraft delivery. You will lead the organization as we scale from prototype and low-rate initial production into sustained manufacturing.

We are looking for a hands-on aerospace manufacturing leader with a proven track record of building production organizations, improving factory performance and delivering complex aircraft in FAA-regulated environments.

**Why join:** Most manufacturing leadership roles optimize an existing production system. This one builds it. You will establish the manufacturing organization, develop the factory workforce, and scale production of one of the most ambitious autonomous aircraft programs in aerospace.

Responsibilities

 

**Production leadership**

 

* Lead all aircraft production and manufacturing operations.
* Drive safe, efficient and repeatable aircraft production.
* Build and lead a high-performing manufacturing organization, with clear management systems, metrics and operating rhythms.
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, quality and continuous improvement.

 

**Assembly and integration**

* Oversee final assembly, systems and electrical integration, avionics installation and aircraft completion.
* Ensure aircraft are built to engineering, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Drive production readiness and resolve manufacturing constraints and bottlenecks.

 

**Production planning and execution**

* Own execution of the Master Production Schedule.
* Lead production planning, labor allocation and resource management.
* Set capacity plans that support production-rate growth.
* Monitor factory performance and drive throughput, productivity and efficiency improvements.

 

**Production testing and acceptance**

* Lead production acceptance testing and ground test operations.
* Coordinate production readiness with Engineering, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.
* Ensure aircraft move smoothly from production through acceptance and delivery.

 

**Regulatory compliance and quality**

* Ensure compliance with FAA Part 21 production requirements and the company quality management system.
* Maintain production configuration control and manufacturing documentation discipline.
* Support internal, regulatory and customer audits and certification activities.
* Partner with Quality leadership to improve first-pass yield.

 

**Growth and scale-up**

* Develop the manufacturing infrastructure, facilities and staffing plans needed for higher production rates.
* Implement lean manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives.

 

**People leadership**

* Recruit, develop and mentor production leaders and technical staff.
* Establish workforce development and skills-training programs.
* Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations and Program Management.

 

Success Measures

You will be measured on aircraft delivery performance, production schedule attainment, factory throughput, labor productivity, manufacturing cost, quality and first-pass yield, safety, production-rate readiness, and workforce development and retention.

Required Qualifications

 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Aerospace, Operations or a related technical field.
* 15+ years of progressive aerospace manufacturing leadership experience, including 10+ years leading production organizations in aerospace, defense, aviation or another highly regulated industry.
* Proven experience scaling manufacturing from development, prototype or low-rate production to higher-rate production.
* Experience leading large, cross-functional manufacturing organizations.
* Strong understanding of production planning, factory operations, quality systems and manufacturing performance metrics.
* Experience implementing lean manufacturing and operational excellence initiatives.
* Excellent communication, leadership and organizational skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business or Operations.
* FAA Part 21 production experience and experience with certified aircraft manufacturing programs.
* Experience leading final assembly and aircraft integration organizations.
* Experience supporting aircraft certification, conformity and production acceptance.
* Background in autonomous aircraft, UAS, defense aviation or advanced aerospace systems.
* Experience building greenfield or fast-growing manufacturing operations.
* Composite aircraft manufacturing experience.
* AS9100 quality system experience.

 

Please Note

 

* **Security clearance requirement:** This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required.

* **One application per candidate:** Please apply to one position only. If you are interested in other open roles, list them in the Notes section of your application.

* **Check your spam folder:** We use BambooHR, a third-party recruiting platform, to contact candidates. Please check your spam or junk folder regularly so you don't miss our messages.

* **English CV:** Please submit your resume in English.

 

Company Benefits

 

* **Health insurance:** Medical, dental and vision coverage for all full-time employees.
* **401(k) retirement plan:** A 401(k) plan to help you save for retirement.
* **Paid time off:** Vacation, sick leave and personal days.
* **Flexible schedules:** Flexible working hours to support a healthy work-life balance.
* **Professional development:** Training, education and tuition reimbursement opportunities to help you grow your skills and career.
* **Wellness programs:** Programs that support healthy living, which may include gym memberships, nutrition counseling or stress-management classes.
* **Stock options:** Full-time employees may be eligible for stock options after one year of service.
* **Performance bonuses:** Bonus opportunities that reward individual and company performance.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Skydweller Aero Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law, subject to the security clearance requirements above.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at [email].

Privacy and AI

By applying, you acknowledge our [Applicant Privacy Notice]. We may use AI-assisted tools to help review applications, but all hiring decisions are made by people.

card.title: Sr. Director, Club Operations - Boston
card.description:
**Sr. Director, Club Operations - Boston**

Overview

**WHO WE ARE**

Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door.

We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life.

**WHAT WE DO**

We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge-and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work.

Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities-we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more.

Job Description 
Reporting to the Regional Vice President of Operations, the Sr. Club Operations Director will be responsible for maintaining Equinox Standards across an assigned market area. This leadership role demands a deep understanding of Club management, with a focus on driving sales, enhancing the member experience, and ensuring that the Equinox’s luxury image is consistently upheld. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will lead and manage a group of General Managers and will with closely to lead Club and Ancillary teams, implement strategic initiatives and hold teams accountable for delivering results. The Sr. Director of Club Operations will have a strong presence in driving membership sales, maintaining operational excellence, and fostering a culture of success, guided by our core values.

**Operations Management**

* Member experience and satisfaction
* Facilities maintenance and cleanliness
* Staff management and development
* Group fitness programming
* Personal training programs
* Compliance with safety and hygiene standards

**Financial Performance**

* Achieve revenue targets and control expenses
* Manage budgets and analyze financial reports
* Identify opportunities for growth and profitability

**Team Leadership**

* Recruit, hire, train, and develop department managers
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment
* Motivate and inspire staff to achieve goals
* Conduct performance reviews and provide feedback

**Member Engagement**

* Build relationships with members and address their needs
* Resolve member complaints and issues
* Create a welcoming and inclusive atmosphere
* Brand Standards:
* Ensure adherence to Equinox brand guidelines and service standards
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and presentation

\*

* Implement marketing and promotional initiatives

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Daily**

* Team Engagement - huddles, meetings, workouts
* Coaching GMs - Focusing on leadership and strategy
* Club Visit and Walk Through - 1-2 clubs/day
* 1on1 business meetings with GMs, AGMs and Regional Leaders

* Review clubs appointments - previous day activities (prospects, sales, equifits)
* Structured 1on1 GM Meetings - 30 min in person at least 2-3x/week
* Schedule Accountability - Checking schedules on arcon, verifying in person

**Monthly**

* GM & AGM development - ensuring it's happening (either directly or GM is delivering), schedule, reviews, learning

* People Pipeline - Staffing for future needs, identifying talent for growth
* Sales Strategy and Accountability - ensure systems and processes are being followed
* Alignment and collaboration with regionals - AE, Ancillary, Sales
* Attend PT Forums when applicable
* Stepping in when the GM requires support
* Full facility inspections - 2/week
* Meet with Regional leaders ancillary every other week/monthly
* Calls - RVP Regional call, Senior Club Director call, GM call

**PERFORMANCE TARGETS:**

100-110% in the following areas:

* New Sales
* Attrition
* Total Operating Revenue/Earnings
* Total Contribution/Profit

Qualifications

* 10+ years of experience in club operations, hospitality, fitness, or a related industry, with at least 3 years in a Sr. leadership role
* Proven track record of overseeing multiple clubs (units) or a high-volume club (facility)
* Strong background in upholding operational efficiency, utilizing & implementing standard operation procedures (SOPs), and ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards
* Experience in facility management, including maintenance, equipment, vendor relations, and tech integrations for operational excellence
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, P&L management, and cost control
* Ability to develop and implement revenue growth strategies through membership sales, service offerings, and ancillary revenue streams
* High proficiency in financial reporting, KPI tracking, and data-driven decision-making
* Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and develop high-performing teams across multiple functions of the business
* Experience in talent acquisition, performance management, and employee engagement
* Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive a positive culture of accountability and performance
* Understanding of member engagement strategies, retention, and delivering an exceptional member experience
* Strong commitment to member engagement scores and ability to utilize feedback and implement improvements
* Strong problem-solver and decision maker
* Internal Employees:No RODs in the last 6 months

**Pay Transparency: $150,000-160,000 annually: eligible for additional bonus opportunities**

**This role is based in the Boston market and requires regular travel within the assigned micro-market to support business needs and operational priorities.**

Additional Information 
**AS A MEMBER OF THE EQUINOX TEAM YOU WILL RECEIVE:**

* We offer competitive salary, benefits, and industry leading commission opportunities for club employees
* Complimentary Club membership
* Perks and incentives with our products and services including Personal Training, Pilates, Spa and Shop

This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operations of the department.

**Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at** ***https://careers.equinox.com/***

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United States.

card.title: Director Field Service Operations – Southeast Region
card.description:
The **Director, Field Service Operations - Southeast Region** will lead and execute the strategic and operational direction of the L/M/HV Services business across a regional footprint, with clear ownership for safety performance, quality execution, financial delivery, and disciplined project management. This leader will be responsible for P&L performance, team leadership, and customer satisfaction across aftermarket services, lifecycle programs, and project execution within the region. The role is central to driving business growth, strengthening operational controls, developing talent, and ensuring field work is planned, executed, and closed out with strong safety, quality, cost, and schedule discipline.

 

This is a **hybrid position** based out of one of our Field Service corporate offices within the **Southeast Region**. The role requires **approximately 40% travel** throughout the assigned region to support business operations, customer relationships, field service teams, and business development initiatives.

 

**Strategic & Financial Leadership**

* Define and execute the service strategy for M/HV products in alignment with regional and corporate objectives.
* Develop and lead growth plans for aftermarket services, engineering solutions, and lifecycle contracts.
* Expand and evolve service offerings (e.g., retrofits, upgrades, and maintenance agreements).
* Ownership of the service P&L for the M/HV segment, including revenue, margin, cost controls, and EBITDA for the defined area.
* Work collaboratively with the President to focus on pricing strategy, cost management, margin optimization, and budget planning for the Southeast region.

 

**Operational Excellence**

* Oversee delivery of safe, high-quality services across all active projects and accounts, while delighting the customer.
* Leverage operational tools (Salesforce, Power BI, etc.) to track KPIs and drive data-informed decisions.
* Ensure efficient use of internal labor and subcontractors, oversee backlog management, inventory, receivables, and timely project execution.
* Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and best practice across field operations.

 

**T****eam Leadership**

* Lead, engage and motivate a diverse, multi-disciplinary team including Managers, PMs, Supervisors, Engineers, and Field Technicians.
* Champion a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, and excellence in customer service delivery through our core values.
* Develop and mentor leadership and technical talent, with a focus on building a NETA certified workforce.
* Ensure all work is performed in accordance with health and safety requirements and in compliance with state and federal regulations.
* Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, hiring strategies, and technical development programs.

 

**Customer & Commercial Engagement**

* Support President on strategic customer accounts; manage escalations and ensure satisfaction.
* Drive alignment between operations and sales to deliver on service bookings, upsell/cross-sell opportunities, and long-term agreements.
* Actively support the development of complex bids, proposals, and emergency response strategies.
* Participate in customer site visits and strategic planning meetings for projects.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 10+ years in Field Services, Power Systems, or Industrial Services with direct P&L ownership.
* Strong financial acumen and demonstrated experience managing a full P&L, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing, margin improvement, cost control, and working capital performance.
* Proven leadership of multi-site service operations and technical field teams.
* Strong understanding of M/HV systems, NETA testing requirements, and utility/industrial service environments.
* Experience with Salesforce, project management tools, and business analytics platforms.
* Ability to travel 25-40% to support operations, team development, and customer engagement.

 

**Preferred Certifications & Skills:**

* NETA Certification or strong familiarity with NETA testing protocols.
* OSHA, NFPA 70E, or similar safety compliance certifications.
* Strong interpersonal skills and executive presence.
* Change leadership and process improvement (Lean/Six Sigma a plus).

**Where Potential Powers Progress**

At Sunbelt Solomon, we believe progress starts with people — their ideas, their expertise, and their drive to make energy work better. With more than a century of combined experience, we deliver full-lifecycle power, energy, and automation solutions across the Americas.

 

From our 40+ locations and a team of over 1,700 skilled professionals, we serve nearly every industry with the people, products, and insight needed to keep the electricity running. Our solutions span low-, medium-, and high-voltage systems, covering the complete electrical lifecycle, from design and engineering to operation, maintenance, modernization, and sustainable decommissioning. We’re known for our expertise in remanufacturing electrical equipment, including transformers and switchgear, and for providing flexible, reliable temporary power rental solutions. Through the Sunbelt Solomon family of brands, including Trinity Power, Magna IV Engineering, and Power Solutions Group, we combine deep technical field experience with advanced engineering and turnkey project delivery.

 

Together, we help customers optimize performance, extend asset life, and achieve sustainability goals while building a more resilient, efficient energy future. At our core, we’re powered by people — innovators, engineers, technicians, and problem solvers — all working together to deliver energy solutions that move industries forward.

 

**Mission, Purpose, Vision & Core Values**

In developing our mission, purpose, vision and core business values, we engaged in a thoughtful process that incorporated the combined principles of our family of companies and reflects our commitment to valuing our history and investing in our people, services, and products.

 

**Mission:** Through a culture of integrity, bold innovation, and customer-centricity we create value for our partners and team members with safe and reliable electrical power solutions and services.

**Purpose:** To enhance the lives of our team members and partners through sustainable products and services in the communities we serve.

**Vision:** To be the leading provider of customized electrical power solutions and services.

**Core Values:**

* People: The core of our success.

* Safety: It’s in our DNA.

* Strategic: We forge our own future.

* Sustainability: Industry leaders in power distribution life cycle management.

* Performance: Delivering excellence at every opportunity.

 

**Company Benefits**

Sunbelt Solomon offers a comprehensive, highly competitive benefits package to employees who meet applicable plan eligibility requirements. Benefits include but are not limited to medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, 401k with company match, life insurance and disability, paid vacation, sick time, and holiday. Temp employees are not eligible for company benefits.

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

 

**Pre-Employment Screening**

Following an offer of employment all candidates are required to complete a background check and drug screen prior to being cleared to start employment. A physical, respiratory fit test, and/or Motor Vehicle Record check may also be required based on the job responsibilities and location of the position.

card.title: FM Global Account and Operations Director
card.description:
**Job Overview**

Flexim Group is seeking an experienced Global Account Operations Manager to provide senior operational leadership for a strategic international account operating across complex sites and manufacturing environments.

Based in Jersey City, you will hold global accountability for operational performance across the account, leading regional and site teams to deliver consistent FM and technical services, safety, compliance and business continuity.

This is a management operations role requiring strong experience, technical credibility and the ability to lead through senior regional and site operations teams. You will set operational standards, challenge performance, manage critical escalations and translate global client priorities into disciplined execution across countries and facilities.

**Duties**

* Lead global operational performance across a complex, multi-country manufacturing account.
* Lead and challenge regional and site Operations Managers, ensuring clear accountability and consistent execution.
* Drive services excellence, with a strong focus on asset reliability, maintenance, utilities and critical infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce global operational standards, while ensuring effective implementation at regional and site level.
* Monitor and challenge operational performance through KPIs, SLAs, CMMS/BMS data, maintenance completion, backlog and asset uptime.
* Lead critical operational escalations.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency, service quality and cost performance.
* Lead global account financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control and profitability.
* Partner with senior client stakeholders, translating strategic objectives into operational priorities and measurable results.
* Act as the senior operational authority for the account, providing executive-level governance, reporting and decision-making.

**Experience**

* Substantial operational leadership experience in Integrated Facilities Management, ideally across a multi-country portfolio.
* Strong working knowledge of hard FM and building engineering services

**About Us** 
Ten Five Hospitality is a growing collective of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues known for concept-driven experiences and standout hospitality. Headquartered between Los Angeles and Miami, Ten Five holds a history of working with and crafting some of the most sought after brands in the world. Ten Five represents the organizational, operational and creative excellence to bring original and authentic visions to life while outperforming the market on the bottom-line.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Operations – Restaurants is responsible for overseeing effective operating procedures within the restaurant while developing a successful management team.

**Daily Responsibilities**

* Plan and direct administration and planning functions of the Food & Beverage department to meet the daily needs of the operation.
* Clearly describe, assign, and delegate responsibility and authority for the operation of the various food & beverage positions.
* Possesses knowledge of all front-of-house job duties.
* Provides financial oversight and prepares and presents financial and operations reports.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all operational systems in use including but not limited to payroll, inventory and purchasing.
* Ensures that all mechanical systems are in good working order and compliant with all federal, state and local ordinances.
* Regulates all executive-level POS functions.
* Oversee and supervise the execution of front-of-house operations to ensure quality, safety, efficiency, and profitability.
* Assists managers in establishing and achieving predetermined profit objectives and desired standards of quality of food, service, cleanliness and promotion.
* Responsible, with the Executive Chef and General Manager, for maintaining the venue’s monthly Profit & Loss statement standards while meeting or exceeding budget expectations through controlling P&L items.
* Oversees that training programs are in place for employees to update their knowledge on relevant industry practices.
* Oversees that the venue is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations and company policies.
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of all food and beverage menus.
* Oversees that all guest and employee concerns are resolved in a way that promotes guest retention.
* Oversees the replacement or repair of all breakage or damage of equipment, furniture, or other company property.
* Ensures front-of-house employees follow all policies and procedures by providing clear guidelines and expectations.
* Maintain professional appearance standards as directed in the Employee Handbook.
* Anticipates and accommodates needs of guests while providing professional and exceptional service to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Protects establishment, guests, and employees by adhering to and overseeing that the Department of Health and company sanitation standards are followed.
* Responsible for management interviewing, hiring, and training process decisions.
* Coaches front-of-house managers as needed and assists in their professional development.

**Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to stand, walk, lift, and bend for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to bend and lift up to 50 lbs.
* Role may include job duties or tasks requiring repetitive motions.
* Exposure to hot kitchen elements or cleaning materials.

**Skills/Experience**

* Minimum five (5) years’ experience working in a general management role in hospitality/nightlife/ bars.
* Passionate about hospitality, food and beverage and morale/culture.
* Ability to think proactively and creatively, have decision making and analytical skills and be effective in written and verbal communication.
* Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, effectively multi-task, and drive results.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays when required.

*We are an equal opportunity employer.*

card.title: Executive Director, Global Commercial Development Operations
card.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

With our rapidly growing portfolio, geographic reach, and Global Commercial Development (GCD) organization, we are seeking an experienced and enterprise-minded Executive Director, Global Commercial Development Operations to develop and implement key business processes, lead department operations, and strengthen planning, communication, and execution as the organization scales. This position reports to the SVP of Global Commercial Development and will serve as a core member of the GCD Leadership Team.

The role will partner with GCD functional leaders, other operations teams, and key corporate functions to establish effective ways of working and clear ownership across shared initiatives. In collaboration with Commercialization Effectiveness and Operations, this role will align GCD planning and processes with the broader commercialization organization.

In addition, this leader will build and lead GCD operations, department project coordination capabilities, supporting disease area teams, Analytics and Insights, Commercialization Partnerships, Companion Diagnostics, and Global Commercial Excellence.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner closely with the Head of GCD, GCD functional leaders, and key partners including HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Information Systems, and Corporate Relations to guide and execute department strategies, plans, and deliverables.
* Establish and manage GCD financial and strategic planning processes, including annual goals, operating plans, budgets, projections, and business reviews. Partner with Finance and functional leaders to track resources, identify gaps, and coordinate inputs into broader commercialization planning cycles.
* Play a central role in defining GCD organizational goals and short- and long-term priorities. Track milestones, dependencies, and progress, and communicate risks and decisions required to the appropriate leaders.
* Lead and plan GCD Leadership Team meetings and other department decision-making forums, working with relevant leaders to set agendas, preparing materials, document decisions, and ensure follow-through on commitments.
* Coordinate GCD participation in broader commercialization business reviews, planning milestones, and shared initiatives, working with the ED, CGCO Operations and other relevant partners as needed. Translate agreed priorities and decisions into clear GCD actions and deliverables.
* Lead coordination of GCD management presentations, briefing materials, and FAQs for launch readiness, portfolio, business performance, and other key reviews. Coordinate with relevant owners to provide consistent GCD inputs for Board, earnings, and other executive engagements.
* Build and lead a GCD project coordination capability to advance department priorities. Define project ownership, plans, milestones, and escalation paths, coordinating dependencies with teams responsible for launch readiness and Global Commercialization Team management.
* Partner with Commercialization Effectiveness and Operations (CE&O) on selected shared planning processes, tools, and ways of working. Coordinate with Global Commercial Excellence (GCE) and other capability teams to clarify responsibilities and support effective implementation within GCD.
* Partner with the Head of GCD to develop and implement a department communication strategy. Coordinate team meetings, project highlights, leadership updates, offsites, and recognition activities to clarify priorities, communicate progress, and strengthen team connection.
* Optimize interfaces across GCD, regional commercial teams, Medical Affairs, Global Access, Research and Development, and corporate functions. Facilitate information sharing, clarify responsibilities, and resolve or escalate operational issues that affect shared priorities.
* Build and scale GCD project management, governance, planning, and operational reporting capabilities. Partner with Analytics and Insights and Information Systems on tools and dashboards that track department execution, resource needs, and organizational goals.
* Lead change management efforts to support organizational growth and drive adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working. Partner with HR and functional leaders on workforce planning, onboarding, role clarity, and team effectiveness, drawing on CE&O approaches where appropriate.
* Develop, grow, and lead a high-performing operations team, including department project coordinators. Coordinate capacity and support across GCD while working closely with project resources embedded in individual teams.
* Establish clear ownership of recurring GCD processes and workstreams with relevant functional leaders. Maintain documentation of processes, decisions, and open actions to support continuity as the organization evolves.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare, including significant experience leading cross functional commercial or commercialization initiatives.
* Experience supporting commercialization organizations, including complex operational planning, launch readiness or brand planning, and capability development.
* Demonstrated Executive Director-level capability, including defining operating models, building organizational capabilities, and driving cross-functional alignment in evolving organizations.
* Strong functional and operational leadership skills, including process design, governance, project management, financial and resource planning, performance management, and change management.
* Proven success partnering with internal stakeholders to improve organizational effectiveness.
* Experience working across global and regional teams, with the ability to clarify accountabilities and coordinate work across different functions and geographies.
* Experience building and leading high-performing operations, or project management teams.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, balancing strategic judgment with hands-on execution and disciplined follow-through.
* Exceptional collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to synthesize complex issues into clear executive materials and actionable plans.
* Sound judgment and discretion when managing confidential information, sensitive organizational topics, and competing leadership priorities.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, or PhD.
* Oncology or specialty pharmaceutical commercialization experience.
* Experience partnering with an executive office or leadership team during rapid organizational growth and geographic expansion.
